# OpenSocrates 1.0.0

OpenSocrates 1.0.0 is the first stable, open-source release.

Highlights:

- 48 authored reasoning systems for Codex Desktop and Codex CLI;
- a local, ephemeral selector with a fail-open privacy boundary;
- English and Korean user-facing content;
- GitHub Release and `npx` installation with layered SHA-256 verification;
- reproducible source, content, schema, security, native packaging, SBOM, and
  release checks.

The prebuilt runtime is validated for Apple-silicon macOS only. Signing,
notarization, clean-machine installation, other platforms, and live host hook
delivery remain explicitly unvalidated.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ParkerHwang/OpenSocrates/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md)
for details.
